map.直角三角形斜边长度。: The hypotenuse length of a right triangle.
map.：已知两直角边求斜边: triangle: find the hypotenuse from the two legs
map.平面距离：坐标差构成的直角边求直线距离: Planar distance: get the straight distance from the coordinate-difference legs
map.：由宽高比换算对角线尺寸: : convert the diagonal size from a width-height ratio
map.算法：直角边 a、b → 斜边 c=√(a²+b²)；∠A 是边 a 所对的锐角: Algorithm: legs a, b give hypotenuse c=sqrt(a2+b2); angle A is the acute angle opposite side a, so tan A = a/b and A=arctan(a/b), while B=90 degrees-A=arctan(b/a). Requires a,b>0.
map.例：a=3、b=4 → c=√(9+16)=5.0000 m；∠A=arctan: Example: a=3, b=4 gives c=sqrt(9+16)=5.0000 m; A=arctan(3/4)=36.87 degrees and B=arctan(4/3)=53.13 degrees. If a=5, b=12, c=13.0000 m and A=arctan(5/12)=22.62 degrees (the classic 5-12-13 right triangle).
map.已知斜边和一个直角边求另一个？: What if I know the hypotenuse and one leg?
map.移项：b=√(c²−a²)。本工具按「已知两直角边求斜边」设计；若求另一条直角边: Rearrange: b=sqrt(c2-a2). This tool is designed for 'find the hypotenuse from both legs'; to find the other leg, swap a and b or compute c2-a2 and take the square root.
map.∠A 是边 a 所对的锐角，tan A = 对边/邻边 = a/b，故 ∠A=a: A is the acute angle opposite side a, with tan A = opposite/adjacent = a/b, so A=arctan(a/b); B is opposite side b, with B=arctan(b/a)=90 degrees-A. The longer side faces the larger angle.
